title: About me
subtitle: One person who handles all of your IT — and takes responsibility for it
description: I'm an IT architect. For years in a corporate environment I designed systems, rolled out automation and trained teams — I learned to see IT from a bird's-eye view and quickly spot where the real problem lies. Today I work solo, directly with small business owners. And that's an advantage: you talk to the person who does the work and takes responsibility for it, not a consultant who passes your case along. I don't sell hours. I sell peace of mind — so your server, data and hardware simply work, and you can focus on your business.

highlights.title: A failure the vendor's support couldn't find
highlights.description: A small firm's accounting and inventory system was about to miss its month-end close. The software vendor's official support couldn't find the cause — I did. On top of that, I gave the client tools to handle it herself, without calling me.

highlights.title: Years of care over the whole infrastructure
highlights.description: A small trading company: for years I've looked after its server, database, backups, network and hardware-replacement plan. I optimized the database so effectively that even the software vendor was surprised.

highlights.title: AI training for nearly 200 developers
highlights.description: I ran an AI-tools training for around 200 developers at a global IT company — rated 4.67/5. I've also presented to an audience of 1,500 people.
